Container.Name: backup-manager-ui
Container.Overview:
The Backup Manager web interface: the shared UI plus a reverse proxy to the engine container. Install the backup-manager engine template first.
This container mounts nothing and holds no state. Everything durable lives with the engine.
Container.Requires: Run `docker network create backup-manager` and install the backup-manager engine template before this one.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The only published port in this deployment. The engine container publishes nothing.

Config.Name: UI bundle root
Config.Description: The per-provider UI bundles the canonical image carries. With --profile=unraid in PostArgs, the bundle served is /ui/bundles/unraid, so an app installed from Community Applications shows the Unraid bridge rather than telling you this is a generic Docker deployment (issue #180). Leave it as it is.

Config.Name: TMPDIR
Config.Description: Go's temp directory. The rootfs is read-only, so this has to point at the tmpfs in ExtraParams.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: This container's own bind address, always :8080 regardless of the host port above.

Config.Name: Engine address
Config.Description: The engine container, by name, on the shared user-defined network. Docker's embedded DNS resolves this; the default bridge network would not.
